title: School Calls 911 After Child Comes To School Visibly Hurt
description:
#news #police #arrest

On October 23rd, 2024.  A girl in her early teenage years reported to her school counselor that her sister was being ab*sed by her dad at home. The teenage stated that her dad yelled at the younger sister, pulled her hair and hit her before pouring hot sauce down her mouth. When officers came to the school to arrest the dad, he became defensive and tried leaving the scene, pushing an officer out the way. This is the bodycam footage of the events. 

*We know muted words aren’t ideal, but they help us follow YouTube guidelines and keep bringing you more content. Thanks for sticking with us*
